## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite flow's validator still accepts 8-character passwords, so the new twelve-character requirement in the PR description is only partly enforced and should be fixed.

## Changes
The PR raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py` and moves their boundary tests to 11/12/13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve too — An invite user can still set an 11-character password, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while signup and reset move to 12. This contradicts the description's claim that the PR "raises the minimum in the password validators", and `tests/test_invite.py:8` still asserts `length >= 8`. — Accounts created through invites can get passwords shorter than the twelve characters the security policy now requires. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update the parametrization and assertion in `tests/test_invite.py` the same way as `tests/test_signup.py`.
